name: Palermo

queries.query: Palermo Italy public cadastral parcel polygon GIS vector map official
queries.scope: Find city-local registry evidence and a safe anonymous geometry-only parcel route for Palermo.
queries.result: Agenzia delle Entrate lists an open WFS for cadastral cartography; the official WFS GetCapabilities request returned HTTP 403 anonymously, so its schema was not inspected. Independently, Regione Siciliana SITR’s official regional ArcGIS service exposes a polygon layer “Particelle” with JSON/GeoJSON query support, native service object ID, and CC BY 4.0 dataset metadata. One exact-point intersection returned one polygon with OBJECTID only.

source.name: Sicilia SITR public cadastral parcels
source.operator: Regione Siciliana / Sistema Informativo Territoriale Regionale
source.serviceType: Official local registry evidence reviewed; safe anonymous geometry status recorded separately.
source.scope: 390 valid distinct cadastral-reference polygons verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged WUP settlement locator. Complete counted paging, forced three-row geometry pages, all 390 fresh exact native identities, explicit absence, footprint and source binding passed in 424 requests. Independent metric EPSG:32633 GEOS found all polygons valid and distinct, with no sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The regional SITR layer publishes native cadastral COMUNE, SEZIONE, FOGLIO, ALLEGATO, SVILUPPO and NUMERO fields. Their six-component reference preserves every literal fixed-width blank, independently of source OBJECTID. A regression test first failed and then passed for that native fixed-width composite identity. Source EPSG:25833 output is faithfully served in EPSG:4326. The original exact-point OBJECTID5685467 sample maps to G273 / blank / 125 / blank / blank / 298 and matches fresh complete geometry exactly. Large composite ID requests timed out and are preserved as failed; a fresh run with configured idBatchSize=1 verifies every short native-identity GET without hidden retries. Published revision/update dates remain informational; their consistency and legal currentness are unverified. Legal title, survey accuracy, currentness, long-term key continuity and wider municipal completeness remain unverified.
